rejected.text: Murasa is a Zendikari island region where a newly risen Skyclave holds the Lithoform Core.
Yenai's refugees crossed the sea toward Murasa, and Lorthos slumbers there.
A second Skyclave holding the lock lies in Murasa, and Akiri hoped to find something powerful there.
The latest page mentioning it says a newly risen Skyclave there holds the Lithoform Core.
